result.title: Brain-Behavior Modeling from Multimodal MRI using Opportunistic Pretraining and Common-Cohort Adaptation
result.comment: 39 pages, 4 figures. This work has been submitted to the Elsevier NeuroImage for possible publication
result.summary: Incomplete imaging coverage limits sample sizes for multimodal cognitive prediction. We evaluated a two-stage opportunistic deep ensemble using baseline Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study data to predict fluid, crystallized, and total cognition. Separate neural models processed structural/diffusion, resting-state, and task-based MRI data with covariates. Models were pretrained on eligible modality cohorts (up to 9,686 participants), adapted to common training cohorts, and fused via Ridge regression (trimodal cohort: 4,216 participants). Five-fold family-aware cross-validation compared this approach against constituent and covariate-only models. Two-stage training increased mean test coefficient of determination (R^2) in 24 of 27 comparisons (median gain: 0.0081). Fusion increased mean R^2 by 0.0051-0.0333 over the strongest constituent and reduced mean absolute error by 0.0067-0.0976. Task-plus-resting-state and trimodal ensembles reduced absolute error across all targets (nominal p <= 0.0108). Task-plus-resting-state fusion achieved the highest mean R^2 for fluid (0.2222) and total cognition (0.3665), while structural-plus-resting-state led for crystallized cognition (0.3706), yielding R^2 gains of 0.0805, 0.1180, and 0.0890 over covariate-only references. Ablations showed expanded pretraining drove most improvements. Gradient-based attribution identified target-dependent input patterns. These findings support using partially observed cohorts for model development to achieve modest fusion gains. Pending external validation, this approach may support MRI-informed cognitive phenotyping.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文利用青少年脑认知发展研究的基线多模态 MRI（结构/弥散、静息态、任务态），以「各模态分别预训练、再适配到共同队列、Ridge 回归融合」的两阶段深度集成方法预测流体、晶体与总体认知分数，并以家庭感知交叉验证与消融比较各模态组合。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是脑影像—认知表型的预测建模，不涉及 VLM 内部推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，其模态级预训练与晚期融合也未给出可迁移到 latent visual reasoning 的具体方法线索，故排除。
